gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads as a plain sans with wide, generous curves and short ascenders under a big x-height, every stroke the same heft. Oswald stands over it, tightly knit.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-imperi: Almendra Display has letters that never seem to pinch shut. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic sits beside it with open, pincer-like c shapes, so the ornate literary heading feels approachable rather than stiff.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Futuristic through and through, Audiowide draws every curve and downstroke with the same pen pressure, like tiles set with wide grout. And Noto Sans Grantha follows with tall, flattened bowls that never snag, so a long stretch of text glides along.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga spreads its flat, single-weight linework across generous tracking, with ascenders that barely clear the x-height. And Oswald, moderate in lowercase height, brings a confident, tightly knit strength that makes the plain sans feel lighter by comparison.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian reads clean, with big open eyes on every e and a and a deep middle band. And across a long passage Almendra Display stays ornate above it while the body keeps the eye moving without a snag.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Audiowide holds one steady line, with no pressure variation anywhere. Noto Sans Gujarati carries a long passage with curved strokes that end before turning inward and large open counters, so reading moves along smoothly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-jp: Almendra Display's letters never seem to pinch shut, giving it an ornate, literary pull. Noto Sans JP does the opposite job, with a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open, handling the everyday reading while the heading handles the flourish.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi reads contemporary, with crayon-thick lowercase strokes. Audiowide above it keeps its horizontal bars exactly as heavy as its upright stems, so the two feel like one modern system with different volume.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta has a big x-height and wide-mouthed curves. Over a long stretch its thickness stays put around every bend, while Oswald, with its more moderate lowercase, reads as the tighter, sterner voice above.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with lowercase that stands tall like capitals. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary curves that never pinch shut, and the plain sans body lets that single quality carry the whole pair.
